derived_results.claim: The H=48/T0=700 three-state I=1 scale is no longer only exact-level certified: a direct-joint Clopper-Pearson + Gaussian path-KL transport construction covers the complete two-dimensional Gaussian shell 1<=D_KL(Q||P)<=1.1 for all 17 discrete split offsets.
derived_results.scope: Gaussian alternatives only; ordinary float64 cover arithmetic; randomized offline power certificate, not an analytic theorem.

derived_results.claim: The same three-state strong scale is randomized-continuum-certified over the larger Gaussian shell 1<=D_KL(Q||P)<=1.25.
derived_results.scope: Same Gaussian/float64/randomized limitations; does not imply all KL>=1.

derived_results.claim: A coarse direct-joint search over mixed mean/variance directions in 1<=KL<=1.1 found no point harder than the I=1 region.
derived_results.details: 6 KL radii x 31 log-variance points x 17 offsets, 500 shared-path draws each; maximum empirical joint failure was 0.046 at I=1, r≈3.8838, offset 14. This motivated the shell certificate but is not itself proof.

derived_results.claim: Brute radial-shell certification is not trending toward a cheap infinite-radius proof even though failure probability improves.
derived_results.details: For new levels 1.125,1.15,1.175,1.2,1.225,1.25, adaptive same-level anchor counts were 75,77,78,82,82,88 while each level's largest joint CP upper generally fell from about 0.0272 to 0.0182. The expanding Gaussian KL level-set geometry offsets the larger transport radii.
derived_results.consequence: Prioritize an analytic high-information tail handoff rather than certifying every radial level indefinitely.

derived_results.claim: For the parallel three-scale bank, each weaker scale need not be certified to infinity if stronger scales cover the higher-information region.
derived_results.statement: Set-theoretically, once the I=1 scale covers [1,infinity) (eventually via finite shell plus analytic tail), the I=0.5/H=96 scale only needs [0.5,1], and the I=0.25/H=192 scale only needs [0.25,0.5]. Exact boundary levels are already separately certified from r73-r75. This reduces the remaining continuum proof burden without changing the detector or PFA weights.
derived_results.scope: Applies only to the parallel-bank union guarantee; it does not upgrade any single scale's standalone floor guarantee.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Previously rejected; r76 instead explicitly certifies a two-dimensional shell using direct joint anchors and convex Gaussian-KL rectangle coverage.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Not yet. Coverage stops at KL=1.25 and float64/CP numerical verification is not directed-rounding certified.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: Continue dense shells indefinitely until arbitrarily large KL.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Deprioritized. Anchor counts rose outward despite improving per-anchor failure probability, indicating geometric cover cost does not vanish.

frontier: Derive or locate an analytic high-information lower-tail bound for the exact Gaussian conditional-SNML adjacent-candidate statistic under subgroup contamination. Use the exact two-normal-population LR decomposition plus explicit SNML regret if possible, so a finite KL handoff radius closes the I>=1 tail without unbounded shell anchors.

If an analytic handoff is not immediately obtainable, test only sparse outer shells to locate a plausible handoff radius and search for a mixed-direction counterexample; do not densely certify every radial level by default.

Replay the r76 1..1.25 anchor-radius and rectangle-corner inequalities with directed-rounding/high-precision arithmetic, including conservative Clopper-Pearson quantiles, before calling the shell machine-verified.

Exploit the bandwise multiscale reduction: certify the middle H=96 scale only over 0.5<=KL<=1 and the weak H=192 scale only over 0.25<=KL<=0.5, using the same direct-joint anchor-ball/convex-cell method unless a sharper analytic route appears.
After the three union bands plus strong-scale tail are closed, compare separable candidate-wise null-infimum against shared-null infimum-after-sum under the same 9-state schedule.
Do not generalize Gaussian evidence to heavy tails/non-Gaussian alternatives without a separately valid robust class.
exact_next_action: Attack the analytic handoff first. Express one adjacent candidate's conditional-SNML logC as a two-sample Gaussian likelihood-ratio information term minus explicit SNML regrets under the exact subgroup representation, then derive a one-sided lower-tail bound uniform over split offset and Gaussian alternatives above a candidate KL radius. If that stalls, certify only a sparse outer shell (for example 1.25..1.5) to estimate where a concentration handoff must start. In parallel, begin the middle-scale band 0.5<=KL<=1 rather than proving H=96 for all KL>=0.5.
